source_law.text: The City Council may designate parking spaces upon City streets or in City parking facilities for the parking of City vehicles. It is unlawful to park a vehicle other than a City vehicle in any such space that has been duly posted or marked.

runtime_uncertainties: Actual Native lane readback, sign pixels, parking motion and camera framing remain unverified until local capture.
City Council designation, due posting or marking, City-street jurisdiction and subject City-vehicle status require independent original records; synthetic fixtures make no legal claim.
City parking facility location alternative requires a separate catalog-cell binding and lead branch review.
unverified_physical_assumptions: Frozen cell can physically realize required law context
Actor blueprint and route can realize each requested behavior
Decisive physical distinction can be seen by retained cameras
source_context_review: City Council designation and posted/marked space need independent context; City-vehicle status is a legal classification, not inferred from color or blueprint. The statute separately allows City parking facilities; this one-way-road cell constructs only the City-street location. The frozen candidate-cell inventory contains no facility layout, so facility coverage remains an explicit unbound alternative for the lead branch review.
